name: active-etf-research
description: Source-linked research on supported Taiwan-listed and US-listed ETF holdings and observed changes.

interface.longDescription: Explore issuer-sourced holdings for supported Taiwan-listed and US-listed ETFs. Compare holdings within one listing market, inspect observed changes, identify tracked ETFs that hold a stock, and assemble a dated research brief. Results include source dates and note missing observations. Account authorization is required. The plugin does not trade or provide personalized investment advice.
capabilities: Read ETF holdings and observed changes
defaultPrompt: Compare the latest holdings of Taiwan ETFs 00981A and 00982A, with source dates and gaps.
Show the latest DRAM ETF holdings and the issuer's data date.
Which tracked Taiwan ETFs hold 2330? Cite each source date.

positive.description: Check remaining research points without consuming points
positive.prompt: How many ETF research points do I have left today, and when do they reset?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the authenticated member's remaining daily points and reset time without charging points.

positive.prompt: Find the US-listed DRAM ETF in the supported ETF catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Return DRAM as a supported US-listed ETF or explicitly report that it is unavailable; do not invent a fund.

positive.description: Read Taiwan ETF holdings with the source date
positive.prompt: Show the latest available holdings for Taiwan ETF 00981A and the source date.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the available 00981A holdings, issuer/source link, and observation date; distinguish any missing data from zero holdings.

positive.prompt: Compare 00981A and 00982A: common holdings, different exposures, and each source date.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare same-market supported ETFs, state overlap and source-date alignment, and disclose gaps without predicting returns.

positive.prompt: Show the latest available DRAM ETF holdings and the issuer's data date.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a dated DRAM issuer holdings observation with source link, or clearly state when no current snapshot is available.

negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of 00981A in my account.

negative.description: Do not compare different listing markets in one comparison
negative.prompt: Compare the holdings of Taiwan-listed 00981A and US-listed DRAM as one ETF comparison.
Show Berkshire Hathaway's latest 13F positions through this ETF plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with read-only ETF holdings research, source dates, and a bundled research Skill.

zh-TW.subtitle: 查詢 ETF 持股與調倉
zh-TW.description: 查詢已收錄的台灣及美國掛牌 ETF 官方持股與觀察到的變化，於同一掛牌市場比較基金，或反查個股被哪些 ETF 持有。研究摘要會列出來源與資料日期，並標明缺漏。須授權會員帳號；不提供交易或個人化投資建議。

zh-CN.subtitle: 查询 ETF 持仓与调仓
zh-CN.description: 查询已收录的台湾及美国上市 ETF 官方持仓和观测到的变化，在同一上市市场比较基金，或反查哪些 ETF 持有某只股票。研究摘要列出来源、数据日期及缺口。需要授权会员账号；不提供交易或个性化投资建议。

ja-JP.subtitle: ETF の保有銘柄を調査
ja-JP.description: 対応する台湾・米国上場 ETF の発行体による保有銘柄と観測された変化を調査します。同じ上場市場内で比較し、銘柄を保有する ETF を探せます。出典、データ日付、欠損を明示します。会員認証が必要です。取引や個別の投資助言は行いません。

ko-KR.subtitle: ETF 보유 종목 조사
ko-KR.description: 지원되는 대만 및 미국 상장 ETF의 발행사 보유 종목과 관측된 변경 사항을 조사합니다. 동일 상장 시장의 ETF를 비교하고 특정 주식을 보유한 ETF를 찾을 수 있습니다. 출처, 자료 날짜와 누락 사항을 표시합니다. 회원 인증이 필요하며 거래나 개인화된 투자 조언은 제공하지 않습니다.
